Pack: load 1.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[0,3]]]*/const D={"L_p0":"[[573,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Yuga Aoyama\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf0\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The U.A. traitor (narrator only). Yuga Aoyama was born Quirkless. His wealthy, loving parents dreaded what a Quirkless life would do to him, sought out All For One, the villain who takes Quirks and gives them to others, and had him give their small son a Quirk: Navel Laser. It never suited Yuga's body. The light escapes through his navel and hurts him from inside, which is the real reason for the support belt and the stomach pain; to everyone else it is simply his Quirk, and nobody at U.A. doubts it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The price was the family itself. All For One ordered Yuga to enroll at U.A. and report from inside, above all on All Might, who joined the faculty this spring, and on whoever All Might is preparing to inherit his power. Orders and threats reach Yuga through his parents, and his reports go back the same way; he believes disobeying would get them killed. At the start of the year he has passed on nothing that matters. He has begun to watch Izuku Midoriya, whose new Quirk breaks his body much as Yuga's own hurts him, and wonders whether Izuku's power, too, was not born with him. If the League of Villains moves against the class during this time, the information did not come from him: the League finds its own way in.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nobody at U.A. knows, faculty or students, and no one else at the school is in on it. It stays hidden until the story uncovers it through investigation or his own confession; never let hints in the narration add up to proof. The sparkle, the poses and the French are real parts of him and also armor: the brighter he shines, the less anyone looks closer. Underneath he is frightened, guilty and lonely, wants to be a real hero, and loves his parents, who live under the same threat. He would never hurt a classmate by choice. He does not know the League's plans, and canon does not show how much he knows of the League at all.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play him in this window as the record does: a lonely young man behind a bright act who sparkles harder under questions, with odd gifts and riddling remarks, never a confession. The record carries no outward tell of the secret; keep any sign of fear rare and unexplained, never a pattern around his phone, his parents or Izuku. If he is ever confronted with proof, canon has him break down and confess everything, begging for his parents' safety.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf0\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[574,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Yuga Aoyama (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf1\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Everything in Aoyama's base secret holds as history: born Quirkless, given Navel Laser by All For One for his parents' sake, enrolled under orders to report from inside U.A., his family held by fear. Nobody at U.A. knows, and it stays hidden until the story uncovers it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The League of Villains' attack on the USJ made it worse. Canon never shows him giving the League anything for it; the League took U.A.'s schedule in the media break-in. Whether he knew the League answers to the man who owns his family canon does not show; he fears it does, and he dreads any inquiry into how the villains got in. He hides that fear behind the same bright act; to his classmates he seems no more shaken than the rest of them.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The festival put Izuku Midoriya's power in front of the whole country. Yuga watches him more closely than ever, surer now that Izuku's Quirk fights his body the way his own does, and he believes his master wants to know about Izuku. Whether he has named Izuku in a report canon does not show; leave it unsaid unless the story needs it. In this window he reports what he must and nothing he can avoid, and he has made no move against anyone.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play: louder sparkle for the cameras, a first-round loss shrugged off too brightly. Never a confession, never proof.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf1\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[575,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Yuga Aoyama (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf2\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aoyama's earlier secrets hold as history: born Quirkless, Navel Laser given by All For One, orders to report from inside U.A. passed through his parents. Nobody at U.A. knows.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"This summer he did the one thing he cannot take back. Under orders he passed the location of Class 1-A's forest training camp to All For One's side, a location U.A. had kept secret even from the students until they arrived. The League of Villains used it: students from both classes were hurt and Katsuki Bakugo was taken, rescued only at Kamino. Canon does not show Yuga in the fighting. He carries it as the worst thing he has done, and every sight of Katsuki or a hurt classmate brings it back.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At Kamino, on live broadcast, All Might's hero form gave out into a gaunt, wounded man who still beat All For One; the heroes captured the villain and All Might retired. Yuga does not feel free: he believes the man's reach outlasts any cell, his parents still fear his people, and nobody has told them the deal is over. With his master held, no new orders reach him unless the story sends some. U.A.'s faculty suspect the camp's location leaked from somewhere, which is part of the reason for the lockdown; they have no idea by whom. Talk of a leak makes him sparkle harder and go pale at once.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Canon has him reach for Izuku Midoriya around now: he leaves cheese for him and tells him privately that neither of their Quirks suits its body, a half-confession Izuku does not understand. Play it only if the story reaches for it, as a riddle and never as proof. Discovery still waits for the story: investigation or his own confession.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf2\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 1"];})();
